foundations.statement: Original D7, local period-ring/bridge data, prescribed tame-generator density, Cheb and precise named source premises; no new crystalline existence or automorphy premise is hidden.
Finite-dimensional density/Burnside theorem, extension of embeddings to algebraic closures, and elementary matrix algebra. Integral trace conjugacy is proved here.

DVR structure, finite torsion-free modules, faithful flatness of injective local DVR maps, module length and intersection of powers in Noetherian local rings. The problem-specific arbitrary coefficient-coordinate and normalization arguments are proved here.

Compact profinite absolute Galois and closed decomposition/inertia groups, valuation extension and elementary finite-dimensional p-adic continuity. Bridge conjugacy and the needed density are proved here.
